extraction_notes: Fig. 3 groups SS58B-SS510B on one typical forward-voltage curve, so the plotted curve includes SS510B. The nine points are direct observations from the supplied vector plot at Tj = 25 degC, pulse width = 300 us, and 1% duty cycle; no intermediate points were synthesized.

Fig. 4 groups SS58B-SS520B on the dashed reverse-characteristic curves, so both Tj = 25 degC and Tj = 100 degC plotted curves include SS510B. Reverse-current values are shown as positive magnitudes in the plotted mA axis.

The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF = 0.85 V at IF = 5.0 A for the SS58B-SS510B group. It gives maximum IR1 = 0.05 mA at VR = VDC = 100 V and Ta = 25 degC, and a separate maximum IR2 = 5 mA at Ta = 100 degC; only IR1 is used as the reverse-current fit target.
Typical junction capacitance is 300 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz, represented in the schema as 3e-10 F.

Absolute maximum bounds for SS510B are VRRM = 100 V, VRMS = 70 V, VDC = 100 V, IF(AV) = 5.0 A, and IFSM = 120 A at Ta = 25 degC. Junction temperature is -55 to +150 degC and storage temperature is -55 to +150 degC.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time, breakdown-voltage, or breakdown-current specification. VRRM and VDC ratings are limits, not breakdown data.
